role: CI gate: counts catalogue keys (shouldTranslate != false) that no code literal requests and fails above .ci/localization_orphan_budget.txt (35).
toplevel: cd to repo root; set -uo pipefail (no -e). SCAN_DIR=$1 or Emuqu/Sources, CATALOGUE=$2, BUDGET_FILE env; missing -> 2; non-integer budget -> 2. Python (copy of the resolution extractor plus multi-line literal support, NSLocalizedString in CALL) builds requested keys from Emuqu/Sources, the watch app and EmuquApp.swift, prints up to 15 orphans to stderr and the count. count>budget -> exit 1; below -> hint; 'clean'.

flags.text: Fails open: if the Python measurement crashes (e.g. unparsable catalogue) `count` is empty, `(( count > budget ))` evaluates the empty string as 0, and the gate prints 'clean' with exit 0. Verified with an invalid catalogue path argument.

The scanning/normalisation code is a copied fork of check_localization_resolution.sh (scan_literal, unescape, candidate_keys, skip_literal_at, first_argument_literals, CALL), not shared; the copies have already diverged (multi-line literals and NSLocalizedString are handled only here). The header claims it 'deliberately shares its extractor'.
